Sun.1: The Sun in its own place produces brilliance and honor
Sun.2: in the second wealth and prosperity
Sun.3: in the third a struggle with the forces of one's enemies
Sun.4: in the fourth praise from assemblies of relatives
Sun.5: in the fifth diseases from bile, fevers, old age, and illnesses of one's sons
Sun.6: in the sixth fear of disease
Sun.7: in the seventh it gives health and slays one's enemies
Sun.8: in the eighth it causes the acquisition of beauty and strength
Sun.9: in the ninth (it causes) distress from anger and wandering
Sun.10: in the tenth it produces joy and gives wealth
Sun.11: in the eleventh it brings about the attainment of the results of one's undertakings
Sun.12: and in the twelfth it causes sickness

Saturn.1: The Sun in the place of Saturn gives learning and glory
Saturn.2: in the second it produces much happiness
Saturn.3: in the third loss of wealth and glory
Saturn.4: in the fourth fame of one's family
Saturn.5: in the fifth the Sun produces a union between one's sons and one's self
Saturn.7: in the seventh it causes respect from one's enemies and gives food
Saturn.8: in the eighth it produces pleasure in quarreling with one's enemies
Saturn.9: in the ninth the Sun gives position and prosperity
Saturn.10: in the tenth there is success in actions and happiness
Saturn.11: in the eleventh it gives various possessions, glories, and joys
Saturn.12: and in the twelfth it causes sickness

Jupiter.1: The Sun in the place of Jupiter produces despondency and delusion
Jupiter.3: in the third loss of position, money, and honor
Jupiter.4: in the fourth ( the native) is the leader of his relatives and people
Jupiter.5: in the fifth the Sun gives friendship with equals, sons, and wealth
Jupiter.6: in the sixth ( the native) subdues his senses
Jupiter.7: in the seventh it causes delusion, wandering, and illness
Jupiter.8: in the eighth hostility, diseases, and wandering
Jupiter.9: in the ninth the Sun gives righteousness (dharma) and money, and (the native) conquers his enemies
Jupiter.10: in the tenth it produces position and business and gives wealth
Jupiter.11: in the eleventh the Sun causes honor, happiness, wealth, and success

Venus.1: The Sun in the place of Venus gives poverty, disease, and wandering
Venus.2: in the second it produces women, wealth, and grain
Venus.3: in the third the Sun gives quarrels with one's wife
Venus.4: in the fourth it causes the misery of his family (varpsa)
Venus.5: in the fifth it gives losses and enemies
Venus.6: in the sixth it produces amusements in many places
Venus.7: in the seventh it gives women and happiness and produces beauty
Venus.8: in the eighth the Sun destroys the pleasure of the body
Venus.9: in the ninth the Sun causes anger and jealousy
Venus.10: in the tenth obstruction in business
Venus.12: and in the twelfth from Venus the Sun brings about success in actions and wealth

Mars.1: The Sun in the place of Mars gives money and sons
Mars.2: in the second it produces many possessions
Mars.3: in the third such things as stealing and breaking
Mars.4: in the fourth beauty, strength, and health
Mars.5: in the fifth diseases from bile, fevers, old age, and illnesses of one's sons
Mars.6: in the sixth fear of disease
Mars.7: in the seventh it gives health, and (the native) slays his enemies
Mars.8: in the eighth it causes joy and good fortune
Mars.9: in the ninth the Sun gives position and destroys evil
Mars.10: in the tenth it causes the acquisition of profits
Mars.11: in the eleventh the Sun causes pleasure with many women and glory
Mars.12: in the twelfth ( the native) is grieved by fatigue

Mercury.1: The Sun in the place of Mercury gives confusion of memory, breaking, and illness
Mercury.2: in the second it causes strife
Mercury.3: in the third position and wealth
Mercury.4: in the fourth quarrels, fear, and wandering
Mercury.5: in the fifth it causes beauty and destroys evil
Mercury.6: in the sixth the Sun is the creator of honor and wealth
Mercury.7: in the seventh the Sun takes away one's voice and one's wife
Mercury.8: in the eighth it produces diseases
Mercury.9: in the ninth the Sun gives knowledge and removes illness
Mercury.10: in the tenth it causes praises from the best men
Mercury.11: in the eleventh (place) from Mercury the Sun produces knowledge, wealth, and beauty

Moon.1: The Sun in the place of the Moon produces heart-disease, grief, wandering, quarrels, poverty, anger, losses, diseases, fears, sickness, and robbery
Moon.2: in the second expenses, weariness, and anxiety
Moon.3: in the third the Sun gives wealth, righteousness (dharma), honor, position, pleasure in friends, and happiness
Moon.4: in the fourth it causes a pouring forth of blood from wounds, fevers, diseases, breaks, and quarrels
Moon.5: in the fifth the Sun gives oppression by the king, grief for sons and relatives, and diseases
Moon.6: in the sixth it produces health, happiness, destruction of one's enemies, joy, fame, and success in business
Moon.7: in the seventh it causes a pouring forth of blood, fevers, weariness, old age, poisoning, and wandering
Moon.8: in the eighth the Sun produces sorrow for wife and sons, illness of relatives, losses, misfortunes, and death
Moon.9: in the ninth the Sun produces poverty, a fall in status, and the hatred of one's elders (guru) and relatives
Moon.10: in the tenth it causes the acquisition of human (slaves), quadrupeds, women, gold, lands, and garments
Moon.11: in the eleventh the Sun gives position, glory, joy, dainty foods, health, and wealth
Moon.12: in the twelfth place from the Moon it is said by experts to obstruct gaining profits from business

Ascendant.1: The Sun in the ascendent gives glory, praise, position, wealth, prosperity, honor, fame, business, food, and gold
Ascendant.2: in the second it gives hunger, fatigue, and disease, and destroys one's accumulated possessions
Ascendant.3: in the third the Sun gives victory, joy, position, good things, wealth, food, and friends
Ascendant.4: in the fourth it produces pleasure in garlands and sexual intercourse, union with one's relatives, and power
Ascendant.5: in the fifth it gives toil for one's family (kula), anxiety, quarrels, diseases, losses, and wandering
Ascendant.6: in the sixth the Sun gives destruction of one's enemies and illnesses, glory, brilliance, joy, respect, and wealth
Ascendant.7: in the seventh the Sun produces anger, wandering, delusion, sickness, theft, and the illness of one's wife
Ascendant.8: in the eighth it kills the body with such things as swords, fever, fear of enemies, imprisonment, breaking, and beasts of prey
Ascendant.9: in the ninth the Sun gives disrespect from the vile, expenses, and the destruction of his acts of righteousness (dharma)
Ascendant.10: in the tenth the Sun gives quadrupeds, clothes, lands, sons, wives, and servants
Ascendant.11: in the eleventh the Sun gives many cows, lands, gold, copper, vehicles, seats, position, and happiness
Ascendant.12: and in the twelfth from the ascendent it takes away treasures and wealth and produces hunger, fatigue, and grief
